# PositionObserver

> Lightweight TypeScript utility that replaces `scroll`/`resize` listeners. Built on `IntersectionObserver` + `requestAnimationFrame` to asynchronously observe changes in a target element's position.

- Repo: https://github.com/thednp/position-observer
- Package: `@thednp/position-observer` — https://www.npmjs.com/package/@thednp/position-observer
- Version: 1.1.5
- License: MIT
- Homepage/Docs: https://thednp.github.io/position-observer/

## Description

PositionObserver provides a `PositionObserver` class (API modeled after `IntersectionObserver`/`ResizeObserver`) that notifies you when an observed element's `top`/`left` changes or when the configured root's `clientWidth`/`clientHeight` changes. Internally it uses a one-shot `IntersectionObserver` (root = `document`) per target per frame + a `requestAnimationFrame` loop — no `scroll`/`resize` events.

Use cases: tooltips, popovers, floating UI, scroll-spy, canvas overlays connecting elements, any UI that needs to reposition on scroll/resize without jank.

## Installation

```sh
npm i @thednp/position-observer
# or pnpm add @thednp/position-observer
# or bun add @thednp/position-observer
# or deno add npm:@thednp/position-observer
# or deno add jsr:@thednp/position-observer
# or npx jsr add @thednp/position-observer
```

Deno (JSR) — import raw TS directly:

```ts
import PositionObserver from "jsr:@thednp/position-observer";
```

NPM / bundler import:

```ts
import PositionObserver from '@thednp/position-observer';
```

## Usage

```ts
import PositionObserver from '@thednp/position-observer';

const target = document.getElementById('myElement')!;

const observer = new PositionObserver((entries, obs) => {
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
      // entry.boundingClientRect, entry.target, etc.
      console.log(entry.boundingClientRect.top, entry.boundingClientRect.left);
    }
  }
}, {
  root: document.getElementById('myModal') ?? document.documentElement, // defaults to document.documentElement
  rootMargin: '0px',
  threshold: 0,
});

observer.observe(target);

// later
observer.getEntry(target); // IntersectionObserverEntry | undefined
observer.unobserve(target);
observer.disconnect();
```

Demo: `demo/index.html` + `demo/script.js`

## API

### `new PositionObserver(callback, options?)`

- `callback: (entries: IntersectionObserverEntry[], observer: PositionObserver) => void` — required. Called when position changes.
- `options.root?: Element` — PositionObserver root. Defaults to `document.documentElement`. **Not** the `IntersectionObserver` root (which is always `document`). Tracks `clientWidth`/`clientHeight` changes. When observing inside a scrollable container, set that container as `root`. Must be an `Element` (not `Document`).
- `options.rootMargin?: string` — passed to internal `IntersectionObserver` only (e.g. `"10px 20px"`).
- `options.threshold?: number | number[]` — passed to internal `IntersectionObserver` only.

Throws `PositionObserver Error: <callback> is not a function.` if callback invalid.

### `observer.observe(target: Element)`

Validates `target` is an `Element` (throws `PositionObserver Error: ... is not an instance of Element.` otherwise). No-ops if target is not connected / not contained by `root` (guard at `src/index.ts:85` uses `root.contains(target)`). Creates initial entry via `IntersectionObserver`, stores in `observer.entries`, starts rAF loop if not running. Duplicate observes are ignored.

### `observer.unobserve(target: Element)`

Removes target from `entries`.

### `observer.getEntry(target: Element): IntersectionObserverEntry | undefined`

Returns stored entry.

### `observer.disconnect()`

Cancels rAF, clears `entries`.

### `observer.entries: Map<Element, IntersectionObserverEntry>`

Public map of current entries.

### `PositionObserver.version: string`

Current package version.

## How It Works

1. `observe()` validates and creates a one-shot `IntersectionObserver` (`src/index.ts:179` `_n`) to get the first `IntersectionObserverEntry`.
2. `_rc()` (`src/index.ts:115`) runs via `requestAnimationFrame`: for each entry checks `target.isConnected`, re-creates entry via `_n()`, filters by `isIntersecting` and by `oldRect.top/left` vs new `top/left` or `root.clientWidth/clientHeight` change (`src/index.ts:142`), collects `updates`, invokes callback, loops.
3. `rootMargin`/`threshold` only affect the `isIntersecting` gate, not position diff.

## Notes for LLMs / Agents

- ESM only (`"type": "module"`). Build with `tsdown` (`tsdown.config.ts`), output `dist/index.js` + `dist/index.d.mts`. Exports at `package.json:11`.
- Runtime dep: `@thednp/shorty` (`isElement`, `isFunction`). `tsdown` `neverBundle`.
- Strict TypeScript (`tsconfig.json:13` — `noUnusedLocals`, `noUnusedParameters`, `noImplicitReturns`).
- Lint `deno lint src`, format `deno fmt src`, typecheck `tsc --noEmit`.
- Tests are browser-only: `vitest` + `@vitest/browser-playwright` (Chromium). See `test/index.test.ts`, `test/getMarkup.ts`, `test/styleTip.ts`. Run `pnpm test` (headless) or `pnpm test-ui`.
- Known nuance: `observe()` guards with `root.contains(target)` (`O(n)`) while hot loop uses `target.isConnected` (`O(1)`). Issue #7 requests `root` not needing to be ancestor (e.g. canvas overlay). Supporting that requires switching to `isConnected` + relative position diff (`targetRect - rootRect`). See `AGENTS.md` Gotchas.
- Do not spread `IntersectionObserverEntry` (not spreadable). Use `entry.boundingClientRect` from `getEntry()` to avoid extra `getBoundingClientRect()` calls.
